scan_unavailable: Scanning is only available on the phone.
group_nobody_to_add: All your contacts are already in this group.
group_invited: Invitation sent to {0}: it waits for their answer.
group_transfer_text: {0} will become the group's creator. You will stay a moderator.
group_trust_legend: Grey ✓: one of your contacts · gold ✓: a contact whose safety number you verified. Touch the check to verify.
group_my_name_hint: The members of this group will see this name. Leave empty to use your usual name again.
group_bans_creator_only: Banned: only the creator can lift a ban.
set_notifications_hint: Shows an alert in the phone's notification shade when a message arrives and the app is not open. Muted conversations stay silent.
set_unsaved_text: Your name or description was changed but not saved. Leave anyway?
lock_hint: Asks for a PIN when you come back to the app after a while without using it. Off by default. It guards the screen: you keep receiving your messages.
lock_wipe_n: Erase this phone after {0} wrong codes
lock_wipe_confirm: After {0} wrong codes in a row, everything the app keeps on this phone will be erased. You can get your identity back with your three phrases. Switch on?
lock_set_hint: {0} to {1} digits. The code is never stored in clear.
lock_invalid: The code must be {0} to {1} digits.
lock_mismatch: The two codes are not the same.
lock_wrong_left: Wrong code. {0} attempt(s) left before this phone is erased.
lock_forgot_hint: Enter your three phrases: they prove it is you and switch the lock off.
lock_phrases_wrong: These phrases do not match this phone.
set_typing_hint: Shows "typing…" to your contact while you type, and shows you theirs. Off, you send nothing and see nothing (it works both ways).
bgsetup_title: Receive messages while the app is closed
bgsetup_text: On this phone the system may stop FreeSpeech from waking up when a message arrives. One setting to accept: "No battery optimisation" (a Yes/No box).
set_wake_hint: Lets you receive messages while the app is closed: a wake-up signal with no content at all goes through Google's notification service, backed by a check every 15 minutes. Off, messages only arrive when you open the app.
theme_restart: The theme applies at the next start. Restart now?
lang_imported: Language "{0}" added ({1} texts missing, shown in English).
lang_invalid: Invalid language file: it needs a name (_name) and a language code.
lang_reserved: That code belongs to a language shipped with the app: pick another one.
attach_no_camera: No camera available on this device.
err_group_banned_cant_add: That person is banned from the group: the creator must lift the ban first.
err_group_use_leave: To remove yourself, leave the group.
err_group_creator_stays_moderator: The creator stays a moderator: hand the creator role over first.
err_group_only_creator_demote: Only the creator can remove someone else's moderator role.
err_group_still_in: You are still in this group: leave it first.
err_group_only_creator_transfer: Only the creator can hand over the creator role.
err_group_not_in: You are no longer in this group.
err_group_only_moderator_change: Only a moderator can change the group.
err_group_key_pending: Waiting for the group key: try again after the next sync.
err_group_only_creator_profile: Only the creator can change the group's name or picture.
err_group_name_length: The name must be 1 to {0} characters.
err_group_description_length: The description must be 1 to {0} characters.
err_group_member_name_length: The name must be 1 to {0} characters.
err_group_picture_big: Picture too large (100 KiB at most) or not valid.
err_group_only_creator_unban: Only the creator can lift a ban.
err_group_invite_none: No invitation waiting for this group.
err_group_invite_invalid: The invitation is no longer valid.
err_group_not_in_this: You are not in this group.
err_group_moderator_invite_direct: You are a moderator: invite directly.
err_group_banned_cant_suggest: That person is banned from the group.
err_msg_own_only: Only the author can change this message.
err_card_expired: This contact card has expired (10 minutes for a QR code, 30 days for a copied card). Ask your contact for a new one.
err_wipe_wrong_phrases: These phrases are not the ones of this identity.
set_keyfile_hint: Type the file's password, then choose it: the app checks that it does open this identity. Nothing is restored or saved.
set_keyfile_ok: ✔ This file does open your identity ({0}…).
set_keyfile_other: ✘ This file opens another identity ({0}…), not yours.
approve_migration_sub: New identity: {0} ({1}…). Check by another means (a call) before accepting.
approve_migration_done: {0} is now followed under their new identity.
approve_migration_declined: The new identity of {0} was refused.
err_contact_moved: {0} moved to a new identity: write to their new account.
err_migrate_same_phrases: These are the old phrases: a new identity needs new phrases.
err_migrate_bad_phrases: The new phrases are not valid.
err_migrate_phrases_mismatch: These are not the new phrases that were announced.
err_migrate_not_sent: No change of identity was sent.
err_migrate_none: No change of identity is waiting for this contact.
set_migrate_exclude_hint: Moderator: at once exclude from my groups the old account of a member who changed identity (the group key changes, a stolen phone reads nothing more).
set_migrate_auto_hint: Automatically follow the change of identity of a contact whose notice is verified. Never for a contact whose safety number I verified. Off by default.
mig_section_hint: Move to a new identity and tell your contacts and the moderators of your groups.
mig_intro: To use when a phone was stolen from you. This phone must already hold your old identity (restored with your old phrases). You will get NEW phrases to save, then your contacts and the moderators of your groups are told: each one decides whether to follow you.
mig_no_groups: You are neither creator nor moderator of any group: nothing to hand over.
mig_group_creator: You are the creator: choose who takes the group over (they will hold all the powers).
mig_group_moderator: You are a moderator: you will step down from this role.
mig_old_phrases: Your old phrases (they sign the notice)
mig_err_no_candidates: Group {0} has nobody to take the creator role: leave it or invite someone first.
mig_wait: Keep the app open until everyone got the notice: a waiting notice goes out as soon as the person connects, but not after the switch.
mig_finish_hint: When you are ready, type your NEW phrases to switch to the new identity.
mig_finish_pending: {0} notices have not been received yet. After the switch they will not go out: those people will have to be told another way. Continue?
mig_done: New identity in place. The app restarts.
wipe_section_hint: Erase your other phones remotely, or get this phone ready to obey that order.
wipe_hint: If a phone is stolen, install FreeSpeech on another one with your three phrases, then order the other devices of this identity to erase themselves here. They erase as soon as they connect while this one is connected. Each phone must have enabled this protection once (the three phrases are asked for, never kept).
wipe_state_on: This phone will obey an erase order.
wipe_state_off: Protection not enabled on this phone: it would not erase itself. Type your three phrases to enable it.
wipe_activated: Protection enabled: this phone will obey an erase order.
wipe_confirm: Every other phone of this identity will be erased as soon as it connects (messages, files, keys). Your contacts and groups stay valid: a thief who has already read the keys can still use them until you change identity. Continue?
wipe_sent: The order reached another device. It will also be offered again for 30 days.
wipe_sent_later: No other device is connected right now. The order will be offered again for 30 days, as long as this phone connects.
err_msg_only_text_edit: Only a text message can be edited.
err_msg_same_conversation: Source and destination are the same conversation.
err_msg_file_unknown: That file is no longer known here: it cannot be forwarded.
err_msg_download_first: Download it first: only a file you hold can be forwarded.
err_msg_reaction_single: A reaction is a single emoji.
err_profile_name_long: Name too long (64 characters at most).
safety_explain: Compare these numbers with your contact's, aloud or side by side. If they are the same on both phones, nobody got between you when the cards were exchanged.
onb_create_simple_text: Enter your first name and tap Create: everything else is automatic. You can save your recovery phrases whenever you like (Backup menu).
onb_paste: Paste my three phrases (one per line)
onb_restore_failed: Your identity is created, but the backup could not be read: {0}
onb_choose_text: What would you like to do?
onb_row_first_hint: I do not have an account yet
onb_row_restore_hint: I already have a FreeSpeech account
onb_restore_text: Enter the three phrases of your identity. If you have a backup file, add it to get your contacts and messages back too.
onb_err_backup_mismatch: This backup was not made with these three phrases. Check them, or choose another file. Nothing was created.
onb_err_paste: The clipboard must hold exactly three lines, one per phrase.
onb_err_book: Could not draw the phrases: try the advanced mode.
phrases_text: These three phrases recreate your identity on a new phone. Keep them in a password manager or on paper, never in a message.
phrases_typed: You typed your phrases yourself: the app does not keep them. Make a backup below, and keep your phrases.
phrases_copied: Phrases copied. Paste them into your password manager.
contact_rename_text: What do you want to call them? Only you see this name. They call themselves "{0}". Leave empty to use their name again.
invite_send_hint: So that someone can add me.
chat_download_asked: Request sent. The file will arrive as soon as the sender is online.
ph_text: These three phrases ARE your identity. If you lose or change this phone without them, nobody, not even us, can get it back. Keep them now, before going on.
ph_warning: WARNING: once you leave this window, these phrases can never be shown again. They are not kept on this phone.
ph_print_hint: On paper, to keep somewhere safe. Do not photograph it.
ph_print_warn: Keep on paper, somewhere safe. Do not photograph or store on a device. The QR code holds the three phrases: scan it in "Restore my identity".
ph_print_failed: Printing is not possible on this device.
ph_printed: Printing started. Put the sheet somewhere safe.
ph_file_hint: Encrypted with a password you choose.
ph_file_warn: Keep the file and its password apart: together they give access to your identity.
ph_file_made: File created. Store it somewhere other than this phone.
ph_skip_text: Without your phrases, losing or replacing this phone will lose your identity for good.
err_vault_password_short: The password needs at least {0} characters.
err_vault_wrong_password: Wrong password, or the file was changed.
err_vault_bad_file: This file is not a valid FreeSpeech key.
onb_row_keyfile_hint: The file made when you saved your phrases
onb_row_sheet_hint: The QR code of your three phrases
onb_err_sheet: This QR code is not a FreeSpeech phrases sheet.
backup_row_phrases_hint: Show, print or save in a protected file
invite_row_share: Send by text, email or messaging app
invite_row_paste_hint: If they were sent to me
invite_paste_empty: Nothing to paste. Copy the message you received first, then come back here.
err_msg_too_long: Message too long ({0} characters, {1} at most). Send it as a file.
err_profile_picture_big: Picture too large ({0} KiB, {1} at most).
err_profile_picture_type: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
err_server_url: The address must start with http:// or https://.
err_server_duplicate: This server is already in the list.
err_server_unknown: This server is not in the list.
err_server_last: The last server cannot be removed.
err_backup_decrypt: This backup cannot be opened: it was not made by this identity, or the file is damaged.
err_phrases_mismatch: These phrases do not match this profile.
err_db_open: The local database cannot be opened: wrong key or damaged file.
err_file_too_big: File too large: {0} MB, the limit is {1} MB.
err_file_not_local: This file is not on this device yet.
set_notifications_blocked: Notifications are blocked by the phone: tap here to open its settings.
group_leave_text: Leave the group “{0}”? You will no longer receive its messages.
approve_suggest_done: Invitation sent to {0}: it waits for their answer.
group_suggest_title: Propose a contact to the moderators
group_description_hint: What is this group about? (300 characters at most, empty = none)
archive_delete_text: Delete “{0}” with all its messages and files? This cannot be undone.
chat_left_notice: You are no longer in this group: read only.
contact_remove_text: Remove {0} from your contacts? The chat is archived: you can still read it, and it comes back if you add this contact again.
onb_create_text: Your identity is computed from three recovery phrases (at least 75 characters each, all different). There is no way to recover it if you lose them: write them down.
onb_unlock_text: This phone lost your profile's key. Enter your three recovery phrases again to reopen it.
onb_err_phrase: Each phrase must be at least 75 characters long.
onb_err_server: The server address must start with http:// or https://.
chats_empty_text: To talk to someone, open "Exchange contact details" in the menu. You can also create a group (Groups menu).
invite_explain: Give this card to the person you want to add (message, mail…). It stays valid for a month and works once. You can generate as many as you need.
invite_paste_hint: Paste the card you received here
invite_copied: Details copied. Paste them into a message to your contact.
invite_sent: Request sent to {0}: the contact will be confirmed once you are both online.
backup_make_text: Creates an encrypted file (contacts, groups, history, attachments) that only your identity can read: handy to change phone.
restore_text: Choose a backup file made with this same identity. The content is merged: doing it again changes nothing.
set_photo_saved: Picture saved and sent to your contacts.
crop_hint: Drag to frame, pinch or use the slider to zoom.
set_saved: Profile saved and sent to your contacts and groups.
set_server_unreachable: Server added, but unreachable for now: it will be retried automatically.
set_diag_hint: Record on this phone what the app does (connections, refusals, sends) for a bug report. Never content, keys or full identifiers. Nothing is sent.
set_diag_empty: The journal is still empty: use the app for a while, then try again.
set_server_private: This server is private: ask its administrator for access, or use the invitation they gave you.
set_invitation_prompt: Enter the invitation the administrator of {0} gave you.
set_invitation_refused: Invitation refused: it is wrong, already used or expired.
set_server_pending: Request sent: waiting for the administrator to approve.
set_request_consent: Your name ("{0}") will be sent to the administrator of {1}, who will decide whether to allow you. Continue?
set_request_note_prompt: A few words for the administrator (optional, 200 characters at most): who you are, why you ask for access.
set_request_sent:
Your verification code: {0}

Give it to the administrator by another channel (phone, in person). They compare it with the one shown next to your request: that is how they know the request comes from you.
srv_private_pending: Private server: your access request is waiting for the administrator to approve it.
srv_private_denied: Private server: you are not allowed on it. Use an invitation or request access (Settings).
set_transfer_hint: On mobile data, file transfers (received, and sent to others) can wait for Wi-Fi. Messages always go through.
set_transfer_wifi_small: Wi-Fi only, except small files (under 1 MB)
sync_prompt_text: This device can copy your contacts and conversations from another device of your identity, if one is connected now. Its owner must type a code to allow it.
sync_code_shown:
Code: {0}

On your other device, touch the "Synchronization requested" notice and type this code.
sync_notify: Another device of your identity asks to copy your data: touch here and type the code it shows.
sync_bar: Synchronization requested: touch to type the code
sync_enter_text: Type the code shown on the device that asks for the synchronization.
sync_cancelled: Too many wrong codes: the request is cancelled.
sync_started: Sending your data to the other device.
sync_none: No other device of your identity is connected.
sync_done: Mirrored from your other device: {0} messages.
sync_refused: Your other device refused or cancelled the request.
set_autodl_hint: Received files smaller than this size (in MB) download by themselves. 0 = never.
set_confirmsend_hint: A file larger than this size (in MB) is only sent after you confirm. 0 = never.
set_kbd_hint: Asks the keyboard to suggest nothing and to learn nothing from what you type (if your keyboard respects it). Applies to fields opened afterwards.
set_secure_hint: Blocks screenshots and hides the app's preview in the list of recent apps.
set_lockscreen_hint: On a locked phone a notification shows neither the sender nor the text, only 'New message'.
archived_hint: This file was put in an archive to free space. Load the archive (Backup / Restore, Free up space) to get it back.
arch_entry_text: Puts old photos, videos and files in an archive file that you place wherever you like. The messages stay, with a thumbnail for photos and videos.
arch_text: The files you choose leave this phone for an encrypted archive file (with your identity's key). The messages stay in the chats with a small 'archived' icon; photos and videos keep their thumbnail.
arch_older_hint: The files of messages older than this. 0 = no age limit.
arch_note: The archive file is written straight to the place you choose (phone, memory card, USB key, cloud): no copy of it stays here. Files are removed only once the archive has been read back and checked.
arch_confirm_text: {0} file(s), {1}, will leave this phone for an archive file. Keep that file: without it they cannot be found again.
arch_no_picker: This phone does not let you choose a place.
arch_load_text: Puts back on this phone the files of an archive made with your identity. Nothing is duplicated: a file already here is not copied again.
arch_loaded: {0} file(s) put back, {1} attachment(s) found, {2} skipped.
arch_load_bad: This file is not an archive, or it was not made with this identity, or it is damaged.
send_confirm_quota: Your server only accepts {0} more today: the rest goes out when the quota is available again.
limit_quota: Your server limits the volume sent per day, and it is used up. Sending resumes by itself in {0}.
limit_rate: You are sending faster than your server allows. Sending resumes by itself in {0}.
err_not_enough_space: Not enough space on this device: about {0} MB needed, {1} left.
set_receipts_hint: Tell my contacts when I have read their messages (✓✓).
newgroup_no_contacts: No contact: add some first, you can invite members afterwards.
chat_delete_me_text: The message will be erased from this device only: the others keep it.
chat_delete_all_text: The message will be erased on the recipients' side (best effort: a modified client may ignore it).
set_outbox_hint: Shows the messages waiting for their recipient. "Stop waiting" keeps the message but stops the automatic retries and keeping the app in the foreground; it goes out when the contact connects.
outbox_gone: This message is no longer waiting.
outbox_delivered: handed to the relay, no acknowledgement yet (resent {0} times)
info_unsent: Not yet handed to the relay
info_delivered: Delivered, not yet confirmed by the contact
